research.title: The Frontend System Design Interview in 2026: What They Actually Ask Now
research.whyTrending: Listings are down ~35% from pre-2020 and ~70% from the 2022 peak, so interview loops got harder and more architectural — rendering strategy tradeoffs, caching layers, real-time sync, and increasingly 'how would you design this so agents can maintain it'. The blog already ranks with a deep JavaScript interview guide but has nothing on system design, which is the higher-intent, higher-volume sibling query and pulls steady traffic year-round.
research.gapNote: Evergreen traffic anchor. Internal-links to BFF, micro-frontends, monorepo, performance-budgets, SSR strategies.
